data.name: Rasikh
data.gender_notes: Rasikh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 's-kh-k', meaning 'wise, intelligent'. This name is often given to children who are expected to grow up to be wise and intelligent individuals, and to make good decisions in life. The name Rasikh carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rasikh usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rasikh is a name that is deeply rooted in the spiritual traditions of Islam. It is believed that those who bear this name are blessed with the gift of wisdom and intelligence, and are destined to use these gifts to serve and benefit others.
data.etymology: Rasikh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rasikh total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: راسخ
in_arabic.meaning: الراسخ في العلم والايمان، الثابت في العقيدة
in_arabic.long_meaning: راسخ هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ر-س-خ' والذي يعني الثبات والرسوخ في العلم والإيمان. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران الآية ١١١ 'وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ أَبرَوا عَلى رِجلِهِنَّ لِيُجَرِّروهُنَّ إِلى الحَديِثِ إِنَّهُنُّ لَم يَكُفُروا وَلَكن كُفِروا بِآياتِ اللهِ وَهُم راسِخونَ في الأَرضِ'، يدل على الشخص الذي يكون له جذور قوية في الإيمان والعلم، مما يجعله ثابتًا في العقيدة والعمل.

in_urdu.name: راسخ
in_urdu.meaning: راسخ علم و ایمان میں، ثابت قدم عقیدہ میں
in_urdu.long_meaning: راسخ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے علم اور ایمان میں مضبوط، عقیدہ میں ثابت قدم۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ 'ر-س-خ' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'ثابت' یا 'مضبوط'۔ اس نام کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں کیا جاتا ہے اور یہ نام اسلامی تقویم اور رسم و رواج میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रासिख
in_hindi.meaning: विज्ञान और विश्वास में मजबूत, आस्था में अचल
in_hindi.long_meaning: रासिख एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है विज्ञान और विश्वास में मजबूत, आस्था में अचल। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'र-स-ख' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है 'स्थिर' या 'मजबूत'। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में उपयोग किया जाता है और इसे इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: راسخ
in_pashto.meaning: په علم او ايمان کې قوي، په عقیده کې ثابت
in_pashto.long_meaning: راسخ د عربي نوم دی چې مانې يې په علم او ايمان کې قوي، په عقیده کې ثابت. دا نوم د عربي ريښې 'ر-س-خ' څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې مانې يې 'ثابت' يا 'قوي' دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او په اسلامي دودیزو کړنو کې مهم ګڼل کیږي.

in_english.name: Rasikh
in_english.meaning: Strong in knowledge and faith, firm in belief
in_english.long_meaning: Rasikh is an Arabic name derived from the root 'r-s-kh', meaning 'strong' or 'firm'. It signifies someone who is deeply rooted in knowledge and faith, firm in their beliefs and convictions. Mentioned in the Quranic context, it implies a person with a strong foundation in Islamic principles and practices. The name reflects a personality that is steadfast, resolute, and unwavering in their commitment to their values and principles.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Rasikh" carries a profound cultural significance in Islamic societies, as intelligence and wisdom are highly valued traits in Islam. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "The best of you are those who have the best manners and knowledge" (Bukhari and Muslim). Hence, naming a child "Rasikh" shows the parents' hope and aspiration for them to be knowledgeable and wise individuals.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Rasikh" signifies the desirable trait of wisdom that is essential for connecting with and understanding the divine. Prophet Solomon (Sulayman), known for his immense wisdom, is considered an exemplar of a wise and intelligent person in both worldly and spiritual matters. By bestowing the name "Rasikh" upon a child, parents are encouraging and empowering them to seek and acquire knowledge, which can lead to a deeper understanding of the Divine and a more meaningful connection with the Creator.
